question: Among the four numbers given below, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• First digit + third digit = second digit

 
• 187 → 1 + 7 = 8
 
• 165 → 1 + 5 = 6
 
• 143 → 1 + 3 = 4
 
• **159 → 1 + 9 = 10 ≠ 5**
